source_note: Wave-2 bounded records for HELIOS-LINK, TIDELENS/Specular MIST, AEROSHEPHERD and BAROS. These are concept/intake fixtures and do not elevate maturity.

records.model_scope: Bounded transmitter-propagation-receiver wireless power-transfer validation pathway

governing_equations.name: end-to-end efficiency
governing_equations.domain_of_validity: declared transmitter-through-load power boundaries with calibrated input and output measurements

assumptions: Wireless power transfer is established externally, but HELIOS-LINK-specific range and efficiency require measurement
Power boundaries, beam/field profile, pointing, thermal state, and receiver capture must be measured separately where practical
Facility safety authorization is required for RF, optical, laser, electrical, and thermal hazards
boundary_conditions: Any test must declare frequency or wavelength, source/aperture/receiver geometry, range, power boundary, and environment
failure_modes: apparent efficiency is inflated by incomplete power boundaries
detector nonlinearity or thermal drift biases received-power measurement
pointing or geometry uncertainty dominates the claimed link performance
hazard_controls: No hazardous power-beaming operation is authorized by this record; approved facility safety controls are required
records.external_safe_statement: Wireless power transfer is established physics, but no HELIOS-LINK-specific efficiency, range, pointing, thermal, or operational performance is claimed as measured by this record.

records.model_scope: Calibrated measured-data validation pathway for radar/electromagnetic detection, localization, classification, and scattering inference
assumptions: Synthetic-data performance and measured-data performance remain separate evidence classes
RCS/scattering inference requires calibration, background separation, geometry, drift and uncertainty control
Near-field or partial-illumination conditions cannot be silently represented as intrinsic far-field RCS
boundary_conditions: Sensor configuration, waveform, geometry, calibration target, background, environment and ground-truth method must be frozen for confirmatory evaluation
failure_modes: background or calibration leakage creates false detection gain
ground-truth uncertainty dominates claimed localization or classification performance
close-range scattering is misinterpreted using invalid far-field assumptions
hazard_controls: No fielded surveillance, safety-critical detection, or low-observable performance claim without calibrated measured-data evidence and applicable legal/safety review
records.external_safe_statement: Radar/electromagnetic sensing is established physics, but no Worldshepherd-specific TIDELENS/Specular MIST detection, identification, localization, RCS, or low-observable performance is claimed as validated by this record.

records.model_scope: Requirements-linked subsystem, interface, HIL, integrated-ground, environmental and bounded-flight validation pathway
assumptions: Component maturity does not silently become vehicle maturity
Verification of specified requirements and validation of mission/stakeholder needs are distinct activities
Speculative propulsion, materials, or energy assumptions cannot close baseline vehicle range/endurance requirements until physically validated
boundary_conditions: Mission/ConOps, requirements, mass/CG, power, thermal, structural, propulsion, controls, autonomy, communications and hazard baselines must be version-controlled
failure_modes: subsystem interfaces fail despite component-level pass results
HIL or ground-test behavior does not reproduce in the integrated article
mass, power, thermal or control margin is consumed by unvalidated assumptions
configuration drift invalidates the evidence chain
hazard_controls: No free-flight or hazardous integrated test is authorized by this record; approved safety, range/airspace, environmental and test-control requirements apply
records.external_safe_statement: AEROSHEPHERD is an integrated-system development architecture; no complete-vehicle flight performance, qualification, certification, endurance, range, or mission-readiness claim is established by this record.

records.model_scope: Non-clinical staged verification and validation of BAROS dose calculation, optimization and uncertainty workflows
assumptions: Mathematical verification, reference calculation comparison, calibrated physical measurement where applicable, and qualified domain review are separate gates
Public or institutional reference datasets do not by themselves establish BAROS clinical performance
No patient-specific clinical use is authorized by this record
boundary_conditions: Software/model commit, solver settings, material/tissue parameters, image transforms, reference dataset and acceptance criteria must be frozen before confirmatory evaluation
failure_modes: held-out cases are contaminated by tuning or implementation leakage
aggregate metrics hide clinically meaningful local discrepancies
coordinate, heterogeneity or interpolation handling is incorrect
measurement uncertainty or qualified medical-physics review is absent
hazard_controls: Research-only status; no patient treatment, dose prescription, clinical deployment, or radiation-delivery settings are authorized by this record
records.external_safe_statement: BAROS remains a research-stage medical-physics computational system; no patient-specific clinical validity, treatment accuracy, regulatory clearance, or clinical-use claim is established by this record.
